rows.grounds: compound of time and identity; ablative-like extent marker
compound of time and nature; instrumental-like means

items.question: How far does the distinction between body and self extend through time before death?
premises: Death equals sleep after prarabdha ceases.
items.inference: The verse marks the limit of discrimination by time-identity and time-nature.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of the ablative and instrumental forms remains unclear.
items.plain_english: As far as by identity with time and by being of the nature of time, thus.
